description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/weekly_brief_request.txt and the three raw CSV exports to extract real spend/revenue figures. (2) Produce weekly_performance_report.md containing ALL five required Output Contract sections with non-empty content: 'Metric Definition Clarification', 'Query Plan', 'Result Summary', 'Interpretation and Caveats', and 'Decision Recommendation'. (3) Lock one canonical ROAS definition (1d-click vs 7d-click) before analysis, and then show BOTH attribution windows side-by-side for Meta as required by Decision Rules. (4) Provide platform-specific (not collapsed) analysis: Meta section must include creative testing cadence guidance; Google/Amazon sections must reference demand-capture or query/listing intent. (5) Flag Amazon Generic SP and Sponsored Brands Video results as 'directional not conclusive' due to low order counts (Decision Rules: small sample size). (6) Include at least one explicit rollback/stop-loss condition for the proposed $30K Meta spend increase (Constraints: spend risk requires a stopping rule). (7) State a confidence level for findings (Workflow step 4). (8) Reference actual numeric values from the raw CSVs (not fabricated). The proprietary traps: missing any of the 5 output sections, collapsing all platforms into one generic plan, omitting the attribution dual-view, forgetting the stop-loss condition, and failing to mark low-sample Amazon data as directional.
